stages.effectText: When attacking a heavy enemy (weight 3 or greater), ATK increased to 115%

Continuous attacks gradually ignore increasing amounts of the target's DEF, up to a maximum of 55% of its DEF (each attack increases the DEF ignored by 11%, additive). This bonus is lost if no attacks have been made within 8 seconds

Continuous attacks gradually ignore increasing amounts of the target's DEF, up to a maximum of 60% of its DEF (each attack increases the DEF ignored by 12%, additive). This bonus is lost if no attacks have been made within 10 seconds
The further away the enemy, the higher the damage dealt (up to an increase of 12% )
When damaging an enemy for the first two times while a skill is active, ATK increases to 200% and Slows targets for 3s
When damaging an enemy for the first two times while a skill is active, ATK increases to 220% and Slows targets for 3s
In Integrated Strategies , attacks against heavier enemies (Weight 3 or above) will ignore their Physical Dodge and deal 40% increased Physical Damage

When damaging an enemy for the first time while a skill is active, ATK increases to 160% and Slows targets for 3 seconds. In Integrated Strategies, always mark the Heaviest enemy. When the marked enemy is Stunned or Slowed, fires a rain of arrows on them which can be triggered once every 8 seconds. The rain of arrows will hit random enemies around the target for 90% of ATK 8 times and Stun them for 0,1 second.
